# #665 — Flaky db-integration: promote_shared idempotent test collides on a fixed fixture string in the shared CI database

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-09T00:04:39Z
Updated: 2026-08-09T00:04:39Z

---

## Symptom

`db-integration` fails intermittently on this assertion:

```
(fail) promote_shared (live Postgres) > promotes a nominated thought into shared-kb with provenance, idempotent
Received: true      # expect(first.isError).toBeFalsy()
```

`src/tools/__tests__/promote-shared.test.ts:409`

## Evidence it is not branch-owned

Observed on PR #663, whose diff is four files confined to the local-clone launcher's child-env projection and its done-means check — nothing in the promotion path imports any of them.

**The identical SHA disagreed with itself.** Both workflows ran commit `93d021da5a9bd765d3732be5807796200f6a67a4`:

| run | event | db-integration |
|---|---|---|
| 31285140355 | push | **fail** |
| 31285183239 | pull_request | **pass** |

That is the #643 two-runs-same-SHA flake signal, available free on every PR because `push` and `pull_request` both run the job.

Locally against a fresh database the file is clean:

```
bun run test:isolated server/tools/promotion.pg.test.ts   ->  7 pass, 0 fail
bun run test:isolated                                     ->  3752 pass, 35 skip, 0 fail
```

## Probable mechanism

The test seeds a FIXED literal content string and both asserts and cleans up by that same string:

- `src/tools/__tests__/promote-shared.test.ts:411-412` — content is a hardcoded sentence, identical on every run.
- `:429` — `SELECT ... WHERE namespace = 'shared-kb' AND content = $1`
- `:391-399` — cleanup deletes by namespace and by that content/provenance.

`db-integration` runs against a shared CI database rather than a per-run isolated one, so two concurrent jobs (the `push` and `pull_request` runs fire on the same commit at the same time) contend for the same logical row. The second promotion of an already-promoted fixed string returns an error, which is exactly `isError: true`. Same shared-mutable-state class as #613/#614 — the tests are not the contaminant.

## Suggested direction (not implemented here)

Make the fixture content unique per run (a run id / random suffix), so two concurrent jobs cannot collide on one logical row, and scope cleanup to that unique value. Alternatively give `db-integration` a per-run database the way `scripts/test-isolated.ts` already does locally.

Filed rather than absorbed, per docs/lane-contract.md round 8/17. Not blocking #663 on this.
